_help: EDIT THIS FILE to change the love notes. 'daily' notes rotate one per day. 'openWhen' are the tap-to-open envelopes. Keep the JSON quotes and commas correct. Rebuild the app (push to GitHub) to update.
daily: You make my whole world softer.
Proud of you today, always. Drink some water, my love.
You are the best thing that ever happened to me.
I still get butterflies when I think of you.
Whatever today brings, you are not alone. I am with you.
You are my favourite hello and my hardest goodbye.
Be kind to yourself today, the way you are kind to everyone else.
I love the way you laugh. Please do it a lot today.
You are enough, exactly as you are.
Thank you for being my person.
Your smile fixes my worst days.
I am so lucky it is you.
Take a deep breath. You are doing better than you think.
You are beautiful, inside and out. Never forget it.
Every day with you is my favourite day.
Rest if you need to. I love you at your slowest, too.
You are my home.
I believe in you, completely.
Eat well, sleep well, smile often. That is my wish for you today.
You are loved more than you know.
My heart chose you, and it would choose you again.
Today I am thinking about you. Just wanted you to know.
You are my sunshine on cloudy days.
Your happiness is my favourite thing in the world.
I cannot wait for all our tomorrows.
You inspire me to be better.
No one makes me feel the way you do.
You are strong, you are loved, you are doing great.
I am always just one message away. Always.
Thank you for loving me. I will never take it for granted.

openWhen.title: Open when you miss me
openWhen.text: Close your eyes and think of the last time we laughed together. I am thinking of it too. I will be right there with you soon.

openWhen.title: Open when you are sad
openWhen.text: It is okay to feel this way. It will pass, and I will be here the whole time. Drink some water, take a slow breath, and know you are loved.

openWhen.title: Open when you cannot sleep
openWhen.text: Let your thoughts go for tonight. Everything can wait until tomorrow. Imagine my arms around you. Sleep well, my love.

openWhen.title: Open when you are stressed
openWhen.text: You have handled every hard day so far, and you will handle this one too. One thing at a time. I believe in you.

openWhen.title: Open when you feel unloved
openWhen.text: That feeling is a liar. You are loved, deeply, by me and by so many people. You matter more than you know.

openWhen.title: Open when you need a smile
openWhen.text: Remember the silly things we do together. You are my favourite person to be silly with. Now go and smile, Cutie.

openWhen.title: Open on a bad day
openWhen.text: Bad days are only one chapter. I am proud of you for getting through it. Tonight, be gentle with yourself.

openWhen.title: Open when you want to feel beautiful
openWhen.text: Look in the mirror and see what I see: someone who lights up the room just by being in it. You are stunning.
